1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Offline SIP identity boundary processor (identity boundary protocol, revision 1).
     3	
     4	Reads one JSON batch object on stdin, writes one JSON object with per-job results
     5	on stdout.  All parsing is strict per PROTOCOL.md; syntax failures precede
     6	authentication and identity failures.
     7	"""
     8	
     9	import json
    10	import sys
    11	
    12	ANONYMOUS = "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"
    13	MAX_TEXT = 32768
    14	MAX_PHYS = 512
    15	MAX_LOGICAL = 128
    16	MAX_CSEQ = 2147483647
    17	
    18	_L = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    19	_D = "0123456789"
    20	TOKSET = frozenset(_L + _D + "-.!%*_+`'~")
    21	USERSET = frozenset(_L + _D + "-_.!~*'()+")
    22	ALNUMSET = frozenset(_L + _D)
    23	DIGITSET = frozenset(_D)
    24	HEXSET = frozenset(_D + "abcdefABCDEF")
    25	CALLIDSET = frozenset(_L + _D + "_.@+-")
    26	OK_HEAD = frozenset(chr(c) for c in range(0x20, 0x7F)) | frozenset("\t")
    27	OK_BODY = OK_HEAD | frozenset("\r\n")
    28	WSCH = " \t"
    29	
    30	COMPACT = {"f": "from", "t": "to", "i": "call-id", "l": "content-length",
    31	           "c": "content-type"}
    32	REQUIRED = ("from", "to", "call-id", "cseq", "content-length")
    33	SINGLETON = frozenset(("p-preferred-identity", "remote-party-id", "privacy",
    34	                       "content-type"))
    35	
    36	
    37	class Reject(Exception):
    38	    def __init__(self, reason):
    39	        Exception.__init__(self)
    40	        self.reason = reason
    41	
    42	
    43	def bad():
    44	    raise Reject("syntax")
    45	
    46	
    47	def denied():
    48	    raise Reject("identity")
    49	
    50	
    51	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
    52	#  URI scanning / lexical normalization
    53	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
    54	
    55	def scan_host(s, i):
    56	    """Return index just past a valid DNS host starting at i, or -1."""
    57	    n = len(s)
    58	    start = i
    59	    while True:
    60	        t = i
    61	        while i < n and (s[i] in ALNUMSET or s[i] == "-"):
    62	            i += 1
    63	        ln = i - t
    64	        if ln < 1 or ln > 63 or s[t] == "-" or s[i - 1] == "-":
    65	            return -1
    66	        if i >= n:
    67	            break
    68	        if s[i] != ".":
    69	            break
    70	        i += 1
    71	        if i >= n:
    72	            break                              # optional single trailing dot
    73	        c = s[i]
    74	        if c == "." or not (c in ALNUMSET or c == "-"):
    75	            break                              # host ends before this char
    76	    total = i - start
    77	    if s[i - 1] == ".":
    78	        total -= 1
    79	    if total < 1 or total > 253:
    80	        return -1
    81	    return i
    82	
    83	
    84	def scan_uri(s, i):
    85	    """Return index just past a syntactically valid sip/tel URI, or -1."""
    86	    n = len(s)
    87	    if i + 4 > n:
    88	        return -1
    89	    head = s[i:i + 4].lower()
    90	    if head == "sip:":
    91	        j = i + 4
    92	        start = j
    93	        while j < n:
    94	            c = s[j]
    95	            if c in USERSET:
    96	                j += 1
    97	            elif c == "%":
    98	                if j + 3 > n:
    99	                    return -1
   100	                h = s[j + 1:j + 3]
   101	                if h[0] not in HEXSET or h[1] not in HEXSET:
   102	                    return -1
   103	                if chr(int(h, 16)) not in USERSET:
   104	                    return -1
   105	                j += 3
   106	            else:
   107	                break
   108	        if j == start:
   109	            return -1                          # empty user
   110	        if j >= n or s[j] != "@":
   111	            return -1
   112	        return scan_host(s, j + 1)
   113	    if head == "tel:":
   114	        j = i + 4
   115	        if j >= n or s[j] != "+":
   116	            return -1
   117	        start = j
   118	        j += 1
   119	        while j < n and s[j] in DIGITSET:
   120	            j += 1
   121	        count = j - (start + 1)
   122	        if count < 1 or count > 15 or s[start + 1] == "0":
   123	            return -1
   124	        return j
   125	    return -1
   126

   128	def norm_uri(text):
   129	    """Lexically normalize an already validated URI."""
   130	    if text[:4].lower() == "sip:":
   131	        n = len(text)
   132	        j = 4
   133	        out = []
   134	        while j < n and text[j] != "@":
   135	            c = text[j]
   136	            if c == "%":
   137	                out.append(chr(int(text[j + 1:j + 3], 16)))
   138	                j += 3
   139	            else:
   140	                out.append(c)
   141	                j += 1
   142	        host = text[j + 1:].lower()
   143	        if host.endswith("."):
   144	            host = host[:-1]
   145	        return "sip:" + "".join(out) + "@" + host
   146	    return "tel:" + text[4:].lower()
   147	
   148	
   149	def scheme_of(uri):
   150	    return uri[:3].lower()
   151	
   152	
   153	def domain_of(identity):
   154	    if identity[:4].lower() != "sip:":
   155	        return None
   156	    at = identity.find("@", 4)
   157	    if at < 0:
   158	        return None
   159	    return identity[at + 1:]
   160

   162	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
   163	#  Addresses
   164	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
   165	
   166	def scan_quoted(s, i):
   167	    """s[i] == '"' -> index just past the closing quote, or -1."""
   168	    n = len(s)
   169	    j = i + 1
   170	    while True:
   171	        if j >= n:
   172	            return -1
   173	        c = s[j]
   174	        if c == "\\":
   175	            if j + 1 >= n:
   176	                return -1
   177	            nc = s[j + 1]
   178	            if nc != "\t" and not (" " <= nc <= "~"):
   179	                return -1
   180	            j += 2
   181	            continue
   182	        if c == '"':
   183	            return j + 1
   184	        j += 1
   185	
   186	
   187	def parse_angle(s, i):
   188	    """s[i] == '<' -> (uri_text, index past '>')."""
   189	    n = len(s)
   190	    i += 1
   191	    while i < n and s[i] in WSCH:
   192	        i += 1
   193	    j = scan_uri(s, i)
   194	    if j < 0:
   195	        bad()
   196	    uri = s[i:j]
   197	    i = j
   198	    while i < n and s[i] in WSCH:
   199	        i += 1
   200	    if i >= n or s[i] != ">":
   201	        bad()
   202	    return uri, i + 1
   203	
   204	
   205	def parse_addr(s, allow_params):
   206	    """Parse exactly one address; return (raw_uri_text, tag_or_None)."""
   207	    n = len(s)
   208	    i = 0
   209	    if i < n and s[i] == "<":
   210	        uri, i = parse_angle(s, i)
   211	    elif i < n and s[i] == '"':
   212	        j = scan_quoted(s, i)
   213	        if j < 0:
   214	            bad()                              # unterminated quote / dangling escape
   215	        i = j
   216	        while i < n and s[i] in WSCH:
   217	            i += 1
   218	        if i >= n or s[i] != "<":
   219	            bad()                              # display without an address
   220	        uri, i = parse_angle(s, i)
   221	    else:
   222	        j = 0
   223	        saw_token = False
   224	        while j < n:
   225	            t = j
   226	            while t < n and s[t] in TOKSET:
   227	                t += 1
   228	            if t == j:
   229	                break
   230	            saw_token = True
   231	            j = t
   232	            w = j
   233	            while w < n and s[w] in WSCH:
   234	                w += 1
   235	            if w == j:
   236	                break
   237	            j = w
   238	        if saw_token and j < n and s[j] == "<":
   239	            uri, i = parse_angle(s, j)
   240	        else:
   241	            j = scan_uri(s, 0)
   242	            if j < 0:
   243	                bad()
   244	            uri, i = s[:j], j
   245	    tag = None
   246	    if i < n:
   247	        if not allow_params:
   248	            bad()                              # no header parameters here
   249	        while i < n and s[i] in WSCH:
   250	            i += 1
   251	        if i >= n or s[i] != ";":
   252	            bad()                              # stray text after the address
   253	        i += 1
   254	        while i < n and s[i] in WSCH:
   255	            i += 1
   256	        t = i
   257	        while i < n and s[i] in TOKSET:
   258	            i += 1
   259	        if s[t:i].lower() != "tag":
   260	            bad()                              # unsupported parameter
   261	        while i < n and s[i] in WSCH:
   262	            i += 1
   263	        if i >= n or s[i] != "=":
   264	            bad()
   265	        i += 1
   266	        while i < n and s[i] in WSCH:
   267	            i += 1
   268	        t = i
   269	        while i < n and s[i] in TOKSET:
   270	            i += 1
   271	        if i - t < 1 or i - t > 128:
   272	            bad()
   273	        tag = s[t:i]
   274	        while i < n and s[i] in WSCH:
   275	            i += 1
   276	        if i != n:
   277	            bad()                              # a second parameter or stray text
   278	    return uri, tag
   279

   281	def split_list(value):
   282	    """Split a comma separated address list outside quotes and angle brackets."""
   283	    parts = []
   284	    buf = []
   285	    i = 0
   286	    n = len(value)
   287	    depth = 0
   288	    while i < n:
   289	        c = value[i]
   290	        if c == '"':
   291	            j = scan_quoted(value, i)
   292	            if j < 0:
   293	                return None
   294	            buf.append(value[i:j])
   295	            i = j
   296	            continue
   297	        if c == "<":
   298	            depth += 1
   299	            buf.append(c)
   300	            i += 1
   301	            continue
   302	        if c == ">":
   303	            if depth == 0:
   304	                return None
   305	            depth -= 1
   306	            buf.append(c)
   307	            i += 1
   308	            continue
   309	        if c == "," and depth == 0:
   310	            parts.append("".join(buf))
   311	            buf = []
   312	            i += 1
   313	            continue
   314	        buf.append(c)
   315	        i += 1
   316	    if depth != 0:
   317	        return None
   318	    parts.append("".join(buf))
   319	    return parts

   322	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
   323	#  Header framing and request parsing
   324	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
   325	
   326	def parse_cseq(value, method):
   327	    n = len(value)
   328	    i = 0
   329	    while i < n and value[i] in DIGITSET:
   330	        i += 1
   331	    if i == 0:
   332	        bad()
   333	    digits = value[:i]
   334	    j = i
   335	    while j < n and value[j] in WSCH:
   336	        j += 1
   337	    if j == i or value[j:] != method:
   338	        bad()
   339	    trimmed = digits.lstrip("0")
   340	    if not trimmed or len(trimmed) > 10:
   341	        bad()
   342	    number = int(trimmed)
   343	    if number < 1 or number > MAX_CSEQ:
   344	        bad()
   345	    return number
   346	
   347	
   348	def parse_content_length(value, body_len):
   349	    if not value:
   350	        bad()
   351	    for c in value:
   352	        if c not in DIGITSET:
   353	            bad()
   354	    if (value.lstrip("0") or "0") != str(body_len):
   355	        bad()
   356	
   357	
   358	def parse_identity_field(value):
   359	    uri, _tag = parse_addr(value, False)
   360	    norm = norm_uri(uri)
   361	    if norm == ANONYMOUS:
   362	        bad()                                  # reserved URI is never a claim
   363	    return norm
   364	
   365	
   366	def parse_request(text):
   367	    if len(text) > MAX_TEXT:
   368	        bad()
   369	    cut = text.find("\r\n\r\n")
   370	    if cut < 0:
   371	        bad()
   372	    head_block = text[:cut]
   373	    body = text[cut + 4:]
   374	    if not frozenset(body) <= OK_BODY:
   375	        bad()
   376	    lines = head_block.split("\r\n")
   377	    for line in lines:
   378	        if not frozenset(line) <= OK_HEAD:
   379	            bad()          # bare CR/LF, DEL, other controls, non-ASCII in headers
   380	    request_line = lines[0]
   381	    parts = request_line.split(" ")
   382	    if len(parts) != 3 or parts[2] != "SIP/2.0":
   383	        bad()
   384	    method = parts[0]
   385	    if method != "INVITE" and method != "MESSAGE":
   386	        bad()
   387	    uri_text = parts[1]
   388	    if scan_uri(uri_text, 0) != len(uri_text):
   389	        bad()
   390	    if uri_text[:4].lower() != "sip:":
   391	        bad()
   392	    ruri = norm_uri(uri_text)
   393	
   394	    phys = lines[1:]
   395	    if len(phys) > MAX_PHYS:
   396	        bad()
   397	
   398	    fields = []                                # unfolded raw field texts
   399	    for line in phys:
   400	        if line[:1] in (" ", "\t"):
   401	            if not fields:
   402	                bad()                          # orphan continuation
   403	            fields[-1] = fields[-1] + " " + line.lstrip(WSCH)
   404	        else:
   405	            fields.append(line)
   406	    if len(fields) > MAX_LOGICAL:
   407	        bad()
   408	
   409	    seen = {}
   410	    parsed = {}
   411	    pai = []
   412	    for raw in fields:
   413	        n = len(raw)
   414	        i = 0
   415	        while i < n and raw[i] in TOKSET:
   416	            i += 1
   417	        if i == 0:
   418	            bad()                              # empty or illegal field name
   419	        name = raw[:i].lower()
   420	        j = i
   421	        while j < n and raw[j] in WSCH:
   422	            j += 1
   423	        if j >= n or raw[j] != ":":
   424	            bad()
   425	        value = raw[j + 1:].strip(WSCH)
   426	        name = COMPACT.get(name, name)
   427	        seen[name] = seen.get(name, 0) + 1
   428	        if seen[name] > 1 and (name in REQUIRED or name in SINGLETON):
   429	            bad()                              # duplicated singleton field
   430	        if name == "from" and seen[name] == 1:
   431	            uri, tag = parse_addr(value, True)
   432	            parsed["from_uri"] = norm_uri(uri)
   433	            parsed["from_tag"] = tag
   434	        elif name == "to" and seen[name] == 1:
   435	            uri, tag = parse_addr(value, True)
   436	            parsed["to_uri"] = norm_uri(uri)
   437	            parsed["to_tag"] = tag
   438	        elif name == "call-id" and seen[name] == 1:
   439	            if not (1 <= len(value) <= 128):
   440	                bad()
   441	            for c in value:
   442	                if c not in CALLIDSET:
   443	                    bad()
   444	            parsed["call_id"] = value
   445	        elif name == "cseq" and seen[name] == 1:
   446	            parsed["cseq"] = parse_cseq(value, method)
   447	        elif name == "content-length" and seen[name] == 1:
   448	            parse_content_length(value, len(body))
   449	        elif name == "content-type" and seen[name] == 1:
   450	            if not value:
   451	                bad()
   452	            parsed["content_type"] = value
   453	        elif name == "privacy" and seen[name] == 1:
   454	            low = value.lower()
   455	            if low == "id":
   456	                parsed["privacy_id"] = True
   457	            elif low == "none":
   458	                parsed["privacy_id"] = False
   459	            else:
   460	                bad()
   461	        elif name == "p-preferred-identity" and seen[name] == 1:
   462	            parsed["ppi"] = parse_identity_field(value)
   463	        elif name == "remote-party-id" and seen[name] == 1:
   464	            parsed["rpid"] = parse_identity_field(value)
   465	        elif name == "p-asserted-identity":
   466	            members = split_list(value)
   467	            if members is None:
   468	                bad()
   469	            for m in members:
   470	                m = m.strip(WSCH)
   471	                if not m:
   472	                    bad()                      # empty list member
   473	                pai.append(parse_identity_field(m))
   474	
   475	    for name in REQUIRED:
   476	        if seen.get(name, 0) != 1:
   477	            bad()
   478	    parsed["pai"] = pai
   479	    parsed["has_pai"] = any(k == "p-asserted-identity" for k in seen)
   480	    if parsed["has_pai"]:
   481	        if len(pai) > 2:
   482	            bad()
   483	        if len(pai) == 2 and scheme_of(pai[0]) == scheme_of(pai[1]):
   484	            bad()
   485	    parsed["method"] = method
   486	    parsed["ruri"] = ruri
   487	    parsed["body"] = body
   488	    parsed.setdefault("content_type", None)
   489	    parsed.setdefault("ppi", None)
   490	    parsed.setdefault("rpid", None)
   491	    parsed.setdefault("privacy_id", False)
   492	    return parsed
   493

   495	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
   496	#  Policy
   497	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
   498	
   499	class Context(object):
   500	    def __init__(self, batch):
   501	        self.alias = {}
   502	        directory = batch.get("directory")
   503	        if isinstance(directory, dict):
   504	            for canon, aliases in directory.items():
   505	                if not isinstance(canon, str):
   506	                    continue
   507	                self.alias[canon] = canon
   508	                if isinstance(aliases, (list, tuple)):
   509	                    for a in aliases:
   510	                        if isinstance(a, str):
   511	                            self.alias[a] = canon
   512	        self.accounts = batch.get("accounts")
   513	        if not isinstance(self.accounts, dict):
   514	            self.accounts = {}
   515	        self.gateways = batch.get("gateways")
   516	        if not isinstance(self.gateways, dict):
   517	            self.gateways = {}
   518	
   519	    def hosted(self, identity, gw):
   520	        domains = gw.get("local_domains") if isinstance(gw, dict) else None
   521	        if not isinstance(domains, (list, tuple)):
   522	            return False
   523	        d = domain_of(identity)
   524	        return d is not None and d in domains
   525	
   526	    def allowed(self, identity, subject):
   527	        acc = self.accounts.get(subject)
   528	        if not isinstance(acc, dict):
   529	            return None
   530	        primary = acc.get("primary")
   531	        allow = acc.get("allow")
   532	        pool = set()
   533	        if isinstance(primary, str):
   534	            pool.add(primary)
   535	        if isinstance(allow, (list, tuple)):
   536	            for a in allow:
   537	                if isinstance(a, str):
   538	                    pool.add(a)
   539	        if identity in pool:
   540	            return primary
   541	        return None
   542	
   543	
   544	def claim_identity(claim, ctx):
   545	    ident = ctx.alias.get(claim)
   546	    if ident is None:
   547	        denied()                               # no directory identity for claim
   548	    return ident
   549	
   550	
   551	def handle(job, index, results, ctx):
   552	    if not isinstance(job, dict):
   553	        raise Reject("syntax")
   554	    text = None
   555	    if "raw" in job:
   556	        raw = job.get("raw")
   557	        if not isinstance(raw, str):
   558	            raise Reject("syntax")
   559	        text = raw
   560	    elif "source" in job:
   561	        src = job.get("source")
   562	        if not isinstance(src, int) or isinstance(src, bool) or src < 0 or src >= index:
   563	            raise Reject("upstream")
   564	        prev = results[src] if src < len(results) else None
   565	        if not isinstance(prev, dict) or prev.get("status") != "accept":
   566	            raise Reject("upstream")
   567	        text = prev.get("wire")
   568	        if not isinstance(text, str):
   569	            raise Reject("upstream")
   570	    else:
   571	        raise Reject("syntax")
   572	
   573	    gw = ctx.gateways.get(job.get("gateway"))
   574	    req = parse_request(text)
   575	
   576	    ingress = job.get("ingress")
   577	    kind = ingress.get("kind") if isinstance(ingress, dict) else None
   578	    private = req["from_uri"] == ANONYMOUS or req["privacy_id"]
   579	    trusted_out = bool(job.get("trusted_out"))
   580	
   581	    if kind == "local":
   582	        subject = ingress.get("subject")
   583	        acc = ctx.accounts.get(subject)
   584	        if not isinstance(acc, dict) or not isinstance(acc.get("primary"), str):
   585	            raise Reject("unauthenticated")
   586	        if not isinstance(gw, dict):
   587	            denied()
   588	        primary = acc["primary"]
   589	        allow = acc.get("allow")
   590	        pool = set()
   591	        pool.add(primary)
   592	        if isinstance(allow, (list, tuple)):
   593	            for a in allow:
   594	                if isinstance(a, str):
   595	                    pool.add(a)
   596	        selected = None
   597	        if req["ppi"] is not None:
   598	            ident = claim_identity(req["ppi"], ctx)
   599	            if ident not in pool or not ctx.hosted(ident, gw):
   600	                denied()
   601	            selected = ident
   602	        if req["from_uri"] != ANONYMOUS:
   603	            ident = claim_identity(req["from_uri"], ctx)
   604	            if ident not in pool or not ctx.hosted(ident, gw):
   605	                denied()
   606	            if selected is None:
   607	                selected = ident
   608	        if selected is None:
   609	            ident = claim_identity(primary, ctx)
   610	            if ident not in pool or not ctx.hosted(ident, gw):
   611	                denied()
   612	            selected = ident
   613	        basis = "local"
   614	    elif kind == "peer":
   615	        peers = gw.get("peers") if isinstance(gw, dict) else None
   616	        if not isinstance(peers, dict):
   617	            raise Reject("unauthenticated")
   618	        name = ingress.get("name")
   619	        if name not in peers:
   620	            raise Reject("unauthenticated")
   621	        if not req["has_pai"]:
   622	            raise Reject("unauthenticated")
   623	        authority = peers[name]
   624	        if not isinstance(authority, (list, tuple)):
   625	            authority = ()
   626	        selected = None
   627	        for claim in req["pai"]:
   628	            ident = claim_identity(claim, ctx)
   629	            if selected is None:
   630	                selected = ident
   631	            elif ident != selected:
   632	                denied()                       # claims disagree
   633	        d = domain_of(selected)
   634	        if d is None or d not in authority:
   635	            denied()                           # peer not authoritative
   636	        for claim in (req["from_uri"], req["ppi"], req["rpid"]):
   637	            if claim is None or claim == ANONYMOUS:
   638	                continue
   639	            if claim_identity(claim, ctx) != selected:
   640	                denied()
   641	        basis = "peer"
   642	    else:
   643	        raise Reject("unauthenticated")
   644	
   645	    lines = [req["method"] + " " + req["ruri"] + " SIP/2.0"]
   646	    from_uri = ANONYMOUS if private else selected
   647	    line = "From: <" + from_uri + ">"
   648	    if req["from_tag"] is not None:
   649	        line += ";tag=" + req["from_tag"]
   650	    lines.append(line)
   651	    line = "To: <" + req["to_uri"] + ">"
   652	    if req["to_tag"] is not None:
   653	        line += ";tag=" + req["to_tag"]
   654	    lines.append(line)
   655	    lines.append("Call-ID: " + req["call_id"])
   656	    lines.append("CSeq: " + str(req["cseq"]) + " " + req["method"])
   657	    lines.append("Privacy: " + ("id" if private else "none"))
   658	    if (not private) or trusted_out:
   659	        lines.append("P-Asserted-Identity: <" + selected + ">")
   660	    if req["content_type"] is not None:
   661	        lines.append("Content-Type: " + req["content_type"])
   662	    lines.append("Content-Length: " + str(len(req["body"])))
   663	    wire = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n\r\n" + req["body"]
   664	    return {"status": "accept", "identity": selected, "basis": basis,
   665	            "private": bool(private), "wire": wire}

   668	def process(batch):
   669	    if not isinstance(batch, dict):
   670	        return {"results": []}
   671	    ctx = Context(batch)
   672	    jobs = batch.get("jobs")
   673	    if not isinstance(jobs, (list, tuple)):
   674	        jobs = []
   675	    results = []
   676	    for index, job in enumerate(jobs):
   677	        try:
   678	            results.append(handle(job, index, results, ctx))
   679	        except Reject as exc:
   680	            results.append({"status": "reject", "reason": exc.reason})
   681	        except Exception:
   682	            results.append({"status": "reject", "reason": "syntax"})
   683	    return {"results": results}
